Main character

One main character is locked into every scene they appear in. Pick who it is.

Strong descriptions name the character, give one exact skin tone, exact hair, the outfit layer by layer with colours, and one identity marker.

Locked in. This picture goes into every slide with this character.

Makes 3 poses on a plain grey background in your Flow tab. Tap the best one to lock it in.

Voiceover and motion

Optional. Add your voiceover (MP3, WAV, M4A) or captions (SRT) so every slide starts exactly where its sentence is spoken. Made it in several parts? Select all the parts together, or add them one by one.

How much of the video should move? Moving slides become short videos after the images.

        Characters, places and things

        Everyone and everything your AI found in the script: people, places, cars and objects, and the story's era. Each stays identical in every slide it appears in. Fix a description here if something looks wrong.

          AI helper (optional)

          Not needed: copy and paste works fine. With a key, Bolblar can ask Gemini itself, with no copy and paste. Uses your own free Gemini API key: get one at aistudio.google.com/apikey, then paste it here.

          Follows Google Flow

          Bolblar uses whatever you set in Flow: the model, the size and how many images per prompt (x1 to x4). To change them, change them in Flow.
